caption: Lalaria Beach, Skiathos
composition: White cliffs and a sea arch from outside the cove · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From just outside the cove, Lalaria is a narrow beach of round white pebbles under near-vertical pale cliffs, with the Tripia Petra arch where the rock meets the water. There is no sand and no pine forest on this shore. The sky is clear, about 5 percent cloud, about 19.6°C, with wind near 28 km/h, so the open water has small whitecaps while the cove is more sheltered. The sun rakes the cliffs from the east-southeast.
